args.description: 2D side-view beat 'em up stage background, Streets of Rage 2 pixel art, strictly flat orthographic side view, the camera looks straight at the wall with NO perspective and no vanishing point, no text, no letters, no people. Mayakovskaya metro station platform hall, art deco: a row of round arches clad in fluted polished stainless steel with pink rhodonite stone trim, on square columns with dark red stone bases; above the arches the ceiling vault with oval niches holding blue sky mosaics, warm cove lights. Under each arch the dark EMPTY track: plain dark grey curved tunnel wall, no train. Low wide composition: ovals touch the top edge, arches are short and wide. Floor: polished light cream stone with red square inlays and thin dark borders, flat pattern. Bottom 48% of the image: wide empty walkable floor seen slightly from above, the base of the wall meets the floor in one straight horizontal line at 52% of the image height (y=94), nothing standing on the floor, clean open floor.

real photo: arch shape, steel and pink trim
